The bundled src/, snippets/src/ and Makefile retain editable source and build instructions.
The local tree contains inherited differences from the v1.5.0 reference, including
custom-rainbow-colors file-tree selectors and compiled CSS; it is not asserted to
be an unmodified upstream release. Original change dates/complete provenance are unknown.
Build entry: Makefile (sass src/base.scss theme.css --no-source-map --no-charset).
A clean rebuild and exact source-to-CSS equivalence were not run in this review.
Some snippets explicitly use AGPLv3; minimal-cards uses MIT. These are not relicensed
by the theme's GPL notice. Full additional texts and mappings are in
../../snippets/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt; original snippet headers are retained.
On 2026-10-20 only this notice was added; theme, source and image bytes were unchanged.
